findings.title: The "moving" refusal of Change folder… is never asserted
findings.body: The "explains each remaining refusal" table covers recording and exporting but not `moving`, so the new `relocateMoving` text (packages/i18n/messages/en.json:2630, mapped in apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/workspaces/relocate-copy.ts:35-36) is never rendered in a test. The main side has the same gap: apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/relocate.test.ts:54 types the harness's `busy` as `"recording" | "exporting" | null`, so `relocateRefusal` returning `moving` (apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/relocate.ts:24-25) is not exercised. Adding `[{ ok: false, reason: "moving" }, /Wait for the move to finish/]` here, and widening the harness type, would cover both.

findings.title: workspaces:relocate row omits the move refusal and misstates when a folder is accepted
findings.body: The row says the folder is "Accepted only when the folder's `identity.json` has the same id" and lists the refusals as recording or export only. The code also refuses while a group move runs (`moving`, apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/types/workspaces.ts:157-158, returned through apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/relocate.ts:24-25). It also accepts two cases without a matching identity: the folder the workspace already points at (apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/registry.ts:849) and a pending-init entry's folder that holds `.kaipu` items (registry.ts:855). Update the row to name the move refusal and those two exceptions.

findings.title: workspaces:move-items row ends mid-sentence
findings.body: The row's description stops at "a group of single moves" and never says what a group of single moves is or does. Complete the sentence, for example "runs one single move after another, each under the same lock and gate as its own call"; the body at apps/documentation/src/content/docs/specs/2026-10-29-several-workspaces-design.md:1506 has the intended wording.

findings.title: workspaces:switch row lists reasons the switch never returns
findings.body: The row says the result is `{ reason: "busy" | "unavailable" | "cancelled" }`. `busy` is not a reason: `switchWorkspace` returns the busy value itself (apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/switch-transaction.ts:50-51, 105-106), which is `recording`, `exporting` or `moving`. The refusal union also has `unknown` and `read-only` (apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/types/workspaces.ts:28-41). This table was rewritten in this pull request, so the row should match the type.

findings.title: Backlog paragraph does not mention the move refusal of Change folder…
findings.body: The Part 1b paragraph says "Change folder…" is refused "while a recording or export runs". This pull request adds the `moving` refusal (apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/types/workspaces.ts:157-158), and the Part 2 paragraph below does not mention it either. Add "or a group move runs" here or in the Part 2 paragraph.

findings.title: Status banner says nothing is implemented, which is no longer true
findings.body: Line 9 says "The spec is written; nothing is implemented." Part 1b is marked 🟢 Ready to validate on line 18 and Part 2 is in progress on line 29, so the banner contradicts the rest of the page. This line predates this change, but the file is edited here, so it can be corrected in the same pass.

findings.title: Whole-group refusal list omits "io"
findings.body: The comment lists the whole-group refusals as "(busy, stale, maintenance)". `moveItems` now also refuses the whole group with `io` when it throws (apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/index.ts:215-217, mapped by apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/move-group.ts:62-66). Add `io` to the list, or say "for example".

contracts.action: Change folder… is refused while a group move runs (new reason "moving")
contracts.equivalent_path: apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/relocate.ts:18-26 (the same refusal used for recording and exporting, via busy)
contracts.before_after: busyNow() now returns "moving" while moveRun is set (index.ts:66-68). It reaches relocate's deps through activeTransactionDeps() (index.ts:343-349) and the spread at index.ts:480. The diff moves `busy: busyNow` out of runSwitch's literal into activeTransactionDeps, so relocateRefusal's deps.busy() is now defined on this path. The relocate path does the same check before and after the picker.
contracts.visible_effect: The dialog's alert shows relocateMoving ("Wait for the move to finish before changing a workspace's folder.") and the dialog stays open.
contracts.failure_mode: A rejected IPC call shows relocateUncertain (workspace-dialog.tsx:154-156). A move that starts while the native picker is open is caught after the pick by relocateWorkspace's second relocateRefusal (relocate.ts:33-34, index.ts:503), so the folder does not change.

contracts.action: The move lock reaches the switch transaction through activeTransactionDeps
contracts.before_after: runSwitch spreads activeTransactionDeps(), so it now gets busy from there. It is the same busyNow function as before, so the value is unchanged. switchWorkspace still checks busy first (switch-transaction.ts:50-51) and again after the window prepare (switch-transaction.ts:64-68).
contracts.visible_effect: A switch during a move is refused with "moving", and the switcher shows the lock text for that state (workspace-switcher.tsx:140-144).
contracts.failure_mode: A refused switch calls broadcastState, so the menu re-lists and shows the lock (index.ts:372-374). Nothing is written.

contracts.action: Change folder… from the switcher menu (workspaces-context changeFolder) shows a toast when the move lock refuses it
contracts.equivalent_path: apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/workspaces/workspace-dialog.tsx:146-160 (the same relocate call and message from the Edit dialog)
contracts.before_after: Both paths call relocate and then relocateRefusalMessage. The new "moving" reason gets its own message here, the same way recording and exporting do.
contracts.visible_effect: A toast with relocateMoving. A cancelled picker shows nothing (relocate-copy.ts:17-18).
contracts.failure_mode: A rejected relocate call shows a toast with relocateUncertain (workspaces-context.tsx:221-224).

contracts.action: The relocate refusal text points users to "Move to" (new strings in en and es)
contracts.before_after: New text. "Move to" is the en label (en.json:2641) and "Mover a" the es label (es.json:2641). The relocateNotWorkspace text is shown in the Edit dialog and in the switcher toast.
contracts.visible_effect: For a folder that is not a workspace, the user is told to use "Move to" for items.
contracts.open_question: The text is only correct if the "Move to" menu is reachable from the Library and editors in this pull request. I did not read the menu component, so I cannot confirm that.

contracts.action: A thrown group move is reported with the reason its error implies (was: always "stale")
contracts.before_after: The catch maps the error through refusalOfError (move-group.ts:62-66): StaleWorkspaceError to stale, MaintenanceError to maintenance, anything else to io. Before the fix every error was "stale", per the open thread.
contracts.visible_effect: The toast shows the reason text for the mapped reason: reason_stale (es.json:2685) or reason_io (es.json:2686).
contracts.failure_mode: runMoveGroup catches per-item throws (move-group.ts:48-51), so this catch only sees errors from before the first item (device id read, gate, maintenance). No item has moved at that point, so "the original is untouched" holds.

contracts.action: The cached device id is cleared when its read fails
contracts.before_after: deviceId ??= loadDeviceId(...).catch(...) resets the cache to null on rejection, so the next group asks again. Before, a rejected promise was cached for the whole process.
contracts.visible_effect: The next group move succeeds after a transient read error. Otherwise the error is shown as io (index.ts:215-217).
contracts.failure_mode: The rejection is re-thrown, so the group reports io and the in-flight move is refused, not stale.

contracts.action: relocate's refusal switch falls through to relocateFailed for an unknown reason
contracts.before_after: The union is now handled exhaustively (including "moving"), so the default branch is reachable only for a value that does not match the union.
contracts.visible_effect: A generic "Kaipu couldn't change the folder." (en.json:2634).
contracts.failure_mode: A value outside the union (for example, from a newer main process) gets the generic text, not a silent success.

contracts.action: Change folder… on a non-active workspace: the registry relocate runs without the gate, after an await
contracts.equivalent_path: apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/relocate.ts:48 (the active workspace goes through relocateActive, which checks busy again after the window prepare)
contracts.before_after: relocateRefusal runs at line 33, then `await deps.registry.checkRelocate` (line 37), then registry.relocate (line 46) with no busy check in between. This pull request does not change those lines.
contracts.visible_effect: If a group move starts during the await, the folder change would be applied while the move is running.
contracts.failure_mode: The move's next item resolves the target path again (index.ts:187), so an item in flight could be placed in the old folder while the registry points at the new one. This is unverified.
contracts.open_question: Can a group move start between the busy check at relocate.ts:33 and registry.relocate at relocate.ts:46, and if so is the target folder changed mid-move? The window is one checkRelocate call, so it may be too short to matter. Confirm by reading checkRelocate (registry.ts:832-858) and the move's resolveMoveSide (index.ts:105-111).

thread_replies.reply: Addressed. index.ts:215-217 now maps the thrown error with refusalOfError (move-group.ts:62-66): StaleWorkspaceError to stale, MaintenanceError to maintenance, anything else to io.
Addressed. index.ts:174-177 clears the cached device-id promise when the read rejects, so the next group asks again.

Addressed. The comment on skipped (shared/types/workspaces.ts:252-256) now says only Stop fills it and a whole-group refusal lists every item in failed. One small leftover, raised as a separate finding: the parenthetical omits io, which the thrown-error path also produces.
Addressed. chipLabel (es.json:2639), newWorkspace (es.json:2645) and reason_stale (es.json:2685) now say "espacio de trabajo". The relocate strings added in this part also use it.

structuredOutput.summary: Reviewed the 8 files of part 1. The change adds a "moving" refusal to Change folder… (main busy lock wired through activeTransactionDeps, the renderer message, and i18n keys in en and es). The code paths check out: relocate re-checks the lock after the picker, and the switch and relocate paths share one busy source. No blocker or fix-level defect found. Findings are all "consider": missing test coverage for the moving refusal, and docs that are stale or incomplete (spec relocate and switch rows, move-items row cut off mid-sentence, backlog refusal list and status banner, and the whole-group refusal comment missing io). All four open threads on these files are addressed by the current code. One open question is recorded as a contract (the non-active relocate await gap, which is in relocate.ts, not this part).

findings.title: The "moving" refusal of Change folder… is never asserted
findings.body: The "explains each remaining refusal" table covers recording and exporting but not `moving`, so the new `relocateMoving` text (packages/i18n/messages/en.json:2630, mapped in apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/workspaces/relocate-copy.ts:35-36) is never rendered in a test. The main side has the same gap: apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/relocate.test.ts:54 types the harness's `busy` as `"recording" | "exporting" | null`, so `relocateRefusal` returning `moving` (apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/relocate.ts:24-25) is not exercised. Adding `[{ ok: false, reason: "moving" }, /Wait for the move to finish/]` here, and widening the harness type, would cover both.

findings.title: workspaces:relocate row omits the move refusal and misstates when a folder is accepted
findings.body: The row says the folder is "Accepted only when the folder's `identity.json` has the same id" and lists the refusals as recording or export only. The code also refuses while a group move runs (`moving`, apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/types/workspaces.ts:157-158, returned through apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/relocate.ts:24-25). It also accepts two cases without a matching identity: the folder the workspace already points at (apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/registry.ts:849) and a pending-init entry's folder that holds `.kaipu` items (registry.ts:855). Update the row to name the move refusal and those two exceptions.

findings.title: workspaces:move-items row ends mid-sentence
findings.body: The row's description stops at "a group of single moves" and never says what a group of single moves is or does. Complete the sentence, for example "runs one single move after another, each under the same lock and gate as its own call"; the body at apps/documentation/src/content/docs/specs/2026-10-29-several-workspaces-design.md:1506 has the intended wording.

findings.title: workspaces:switch row lists reasons the switch never returns
findings.body: The row says the result is `{ reason: "busy" | "unavailable" | "cancelled" }`. `busy` is not a reason: `switchWorkspace` returns the busy value itself (apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/switch-transaction.ts:50-51, 105-106), which is `recording`, `exporting` or `moving`. The refusal union also has `unknown` and `read-only` (apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/types/workspaces.ts:28-41). This table was rewritten in this pull request, so the row should match the type.
